title: 液流電池功率介面
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討液流電池電化學、泵浦輔機與雙向電力介面，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore flow-battery electrochemistry, pump auxiliaries and bidirectional interfaces, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。電解液種類、堆疊阻抗與泵流條件依系統而異；本課無化學配製、壓力管路或現場通電程序。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Electrolyte chemistry, stack impedance and flow conditions are system-specific; no chemical preparation, pressure-piping or field energization procedures are provided.

stages.title: 電解液與堆疊
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成電解液與堆疊；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete electrolyte and stacks through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 分開功率與能量設計：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Separate power and energy sizing: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解分開功率與能量設計，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand separate power and energy sizing through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 比較同堆疊配兩種槽量的持續時間，指出不能因此任意倍增功率。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Compare duration for one stack with two tank sizes and explain why power cannot simply double. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 比較同堆疊配兩種槽量的持續時間，指出不能因此任意倍增功率。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Compare duration for one stack with two tank sizes and explain why power cannot simply double. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「分開功率與能量設計」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把液流電池電化學、泵浦輔機與雙向電力介面的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If separate power and energy sizing disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of flow-battery electrochemistry, pump auxiliaries and bidirectional interfaces behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「分開功率與能量設計」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for separate power and energy sizing, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 分開功率與能量設計：原理
knowledge.titleEn: Separate power and energy sizing: principle
knowledge.text: 儲液量主要影響能量，堆疊面積與數量主要影響功率，但泵和電壓仍耦合。
knowledge.textEn: Tank inventory mainly influences energy and stacks influence power, with pumping and voltage coupling remaining.

knowledge.title: 分開功率與能量設計：證據
knowledge.titleEn: Separate power and energy sizing: evidence
knowledge.text: 比較同堆疊配兩種槽量的持續時間，指出不能因此任意倍增功率。
knowledge.textEn: Compare duration for one stack with two tank sizes and explain why power cannot simply double.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：假設堆疊輸出 100 kW、泵浦與輔機共 6 kW、PCS 效率 96%，AC 淨輸出=(100−6)×0.96=90.24 kW。輔機從哪一側供電會改變能量帳，必須先畫邊界。 電解液種類、堆疊阻抗與泵流條件依系統而異；本課無化學配製、壓力管路或現場通電程序。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: assume 100 kW stack output, 6 kW pump/auxiliary load and 96% PCS efficiency. Net AC output=(100−6)×0.96=90.24 kW. The accounting changes with auxiliary supply location, so draw the boundary first. Electrolyte chemistry, stack impedance and flow conditions are system-specific; no chemical preparation, pressure-piping or field energization procedures are provided.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「液流電池功率介面」的「分開功率與能量設計：建立模型」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出能源來源、導體、負載、回流與保護的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「微電網：守住晚高峰」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與隔離低壓模型的接線圖、電流方向、測點與時間戳的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Separate power and energy sizing: build the model” in “Flow-battery power interfaces”. Draw the source, conductor, load, return and protection boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Microgrid: Protect the Evening Reserve” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for isolated low-voltage wiring diagram, current direction, measurement points and timestamps, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.observation: 用三個假設 SOC 的電壓曲線形成最小—最大輸入包絡。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Form a minimum/maximum input envelope using curves at three assumed SOC levels. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「建立堆疊電壓包絡」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把液流電池電化學、泵浦輔機與雙向電力介面的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If build stack-voltage envelopes disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of flow-battery electrochemistry, pump auxiliaries and bidirectional interfaces behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「建立堆疊電壓包絡」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。

knowledge.title: 建立堆疊電壓包絡：原理
knowledge.text: 端電壓隨 SOC、電流和溫度改變，轉換器不能只按名目值設計。
knowledge.textEn: Terminal voltage varies with SOC, current and temperature; nominal voltage alone is insufficient.

knowledge.title: 建立堆疊電壓包絡：證據
knowledge.text: 用三個假設 SOC 的電壓曲線形成最小—最大輸入包絡。
knowledge.textEn: Form a minimum/maximum input envelope using curves at three assumed SOC levels.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：假設堆疊輸出 100 kW、泵浦與輔機共 6 kW、PCS 效率 96%，AC 淨輸出=(100−6)×0.96=90.24 kW。輔機從哪一側供電會改變能量帳，必須先畫邊界。 電解液種類、堆疊阻抗與泵流條件依系統而異；本課無化學配製、壓力管路或現場通電程序。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: assume 100 kW stack output, 6 kW pump/auxiliary load and 96% PCS efficiency. Net AC output=(100−6)×0.96=90.24 kW. The accounting changes with auxiliary supply location, so draw the boundary first. Electrolyte chemistry, stack impedance and flow conditions are system-specific; no chemical preparation, pressure-piping or field energization procedures are provided.
